note: Page images of the documents DoCTA transcribes itself. A document without a Transkribus text export carries no page list, so the images its own transcription runs on are named here. Every key is the fimgstore key of the document entry in transkribus_collection.json, which is the image of the first page; the keys of the further pages need an authenticated Transkribus fulldoc call and are absent until that runs.
